messages:
anya-sec: Heads-up: our S3 scanner flagged several DB export objects without SSE-KMS in prod-export bucket, likely during last night's RBAC migration. tagging for triage. :warning:
deploy-bot: Alert: s3-put-no-sse detected for prefix prod-exports/2026-10-01/ (rule: export-sse-required). Sample: s3://prod-export/prod-exports/db-export-2026-10-01T01Z.sql.gz
ben-backups: how many objects?
anya-sec: currently 9 objects across two jobs (00:58 and 01:03). head-object for one shows ServerSideEncryption: null.
carlos-platform: quick context: migration job `rbac-export-bind v1.7` ran 2026-10-01T00:55Z and swapped the export-service role. the script detaches legacy inline policies then attaches a scoped policy. looks like the new policy omitted kms:Encrypt for the export role.
ben-backups: containment: freeze deletes on prod-exports prefix and tag objects `inc:export-unencrypted=true`. I'll run checksum and tenant mapping.
anya-sec: please avoid notifying customers until we know tenant mapping. legal on-call looped if PII found.
carlos-platform: remediation plan: (1) patch migration script to validate new policy contents before detaching; (2) add CI lint to assert kms:Encrypt present for export-role policies; (3) re-copy objects with SSE-KMS to encrypted prefix and verify checksums. I'll own the script change.
ben-backups: re-copy command I'll use: `aws s3 cp s3://prod-export/prod-exports/db-export-2026-10-01T01Z.sql.gz s3://prod-export-encrypted/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:777777777777:key/abcd1234` then verify md5.
anya-sec: create incident INC-2026-10-01-089 and set severity P2. also add CloudTrail alert for PutObject without SSE-KMS on critical buckets.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-10-01-089 created, assigned carlos-platform.
carlos-platform: taking lead. target T+12h to re-encrypt and T+48h for verification. will post progress. :white_check_mark:
